idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.

The plugin can send anonymous usage counts once a day, only if you allow it. See the privacy policy.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Unbound and unused variables are now reported in comprehension generators such as [ok || K <- K] (#1660)
  • Maps written with record syntax, such as #{a = 1}, are now marked as syntax errors, as erlc does (#1662)
  • A variable repeated in a fun head is no longer reported as unused, and Rename changes every occurrence (#1659)
  • A debug session that fails to start no longer leaves an erl process and an open port behind (#1329)
  • defined(Macro) in -if and -elif conditions is no longer marked as an unresolved function (#1638)
  • Introduce Variable on a selection in a function guard or a macro body shows "Cannot Perform Refactoring" instead of failing (#1628)
  • Introduce Variable with "Replace all occurrences" no longer moves the new variable into a case, receive or fun clause pattern (#1627)
  • and 12 more changes: full list
